additional_info.subject: Description
additional_info.body:
Hello
A client called us because no energy was delivered by charger n. 313806942001 (we can't find it in the asset).
She said that, after pre-authorization on POS and cable connection to the car, the charger said: "connection requested" with setting uploadings going on and it remained stopped on this view, without delivering any energy.
It occurred twice, on Feb7th, from 06.44 am (CU time)
And even after charger reboot, the issue occurred again twice, on a different plug, by POS and by RFid Electorverse: in this last case, the charger approved the RFid authorization and cable connection, without generating any charging session as before, just showed on the monitor: "connection requested.
Please, check what happened.
Thank you in advance
software version
: v7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a+FileHandlerHF

additional_info.subject: ID0477081-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S7 313806942001] Charger blocked on "Connection Request" CRM:03097000458
additional_info.body:
Dear Maria,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your request, and after checking the charger, we see that during multiple charging sessions, the charger didn`t continue charging after authentication, because the network was unreachable.
Right now the charger looks stable and healthy, and after checking the latest charging sessions, we didn`t see any errors occurring.
Please let us know if this answered your request, and please provide us with feedback if you are still facing issues with the charger.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
